title: Acushnet Holdings Corp. Announces Offering of Senior Notes
summary: Acushnet Holdings Corp. (NYSE: GOLF) today announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Acushnet Company (the Issuer or Borrower), intends to raise $500,000,000 through an offering of senior notes due 2033 (the Notes). The proceeds from the Notes offering will be used (i) to redeem all $350,000,000 aggregate principal amount of the Issuers outstanding 7.375% Senior Notes due 2028 (the 2028 Notes), (ii) to repay a portion of the amount outstanding under the Issuers revolving secured credit facility, and (iii) to pay fees and expenses related to the Notes offering. The consummation of the Notes offering is subject to market and other customary conditions. Certain statements in this press release are forward-looking statements.
